title: Wall Mount Towel Bar 30-Inch Solid Brass Carolina Collection Allied Brass
description:
Upgrade towel storage with a 30-Inch wall mount towel bar crafted from solid brass in the Carolina Collection for a refined, traditional look.

Highlights:
- Carolina Collection styling pairs with traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
- Solid brass construction for enduring performance
- Concealed screw mounting for a clean, tailored appearance
- Wall-mounted design helps keep towels organized while saving floor space
- Includes towel bar, mounting plates, and installation hardware

Specs:
- Category: Towel Bars
- Length: 30 in (center-to-center: 30 in)
- Bar diameter: 0.75 in
- Overall dimensions: 30 in L x 3.5 in H x 2 in projection
- Weight capacity: 10 lb
- Material: Brass
- Shape: Straight bar
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Assembly required: No
- Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

Finish options: Available in a wide variety of lifetime designer finishes, including statement colors such as pink, lavender, spanish gold, mediterranean blue, and glokzin teal. Coordinate a matching Carolina look with other heritage bathroom fixtures in the same collection.
